events.desc_zh: 周日12-4点有儿童创业小市集(5-17岁),14:30有万圣节服装比赛(需预先报名)。
events.desc_en: Sunday has a Kids Market (ages 5-17, 12-4pm) and a costume contest at 2:30pm (pre-registration required).

events.title_zh: 达拉斯植物园 秋日南瓜村
events.title_en: Autumn at the Arboretum: Pumpkin Village
events.desc_zh: 用9万多个南瓜搭建的南瓜屋,今年以史努比花生漫画为主题。
events.desc_en: Pumpkin houses built from 90,000+ pumpkins, gourds and squash, with a Peanuts theme this year. Garden hours 9am-5pm.

events.title_zh: Plano 免费 Trunk or Treat
events.title_en: Trunk or Treat at The Learning Experience Plano
events.desc_zh: 装饰好的车尾箱、讨糖、游戏、抽奖,大象吉祥物合影。
events.desc_en: Decorated trunks, trick-or-treating, games, raffles and photos with a costumed elephant.

events.title_zh: ArmeniaFest 亚美尼亚文化节
events.title_en: ArmeniaFest 2026
events.desc_zh: 第31届,有亚美尼亚美食、音乐、舞蹈,设有儿童区。
events.desc_en: 31st annual festival with Armenian food, music and dance; listed with a kids zone.

events.title_zh: Scarborough's Hollow 秋季奇幻节
events.title_en: Scarborough's Hollow Fall Fantasy Festival
events.desc_zh: 童话村庄,现场表演、手工艺摊位和互动游戏,鼓励亲子装扮(距市区约30英里)。
events.desc_en: Enchanted village with live shows, artisan shops and interactive attractions; family costumes encouraged. About 30 miles south of Dallas.

dc.notes_zh: 本周未找到可核实的华人/亚裔亲子活动(重阳节活动未见,La Vang 中秋节在9月),因此全部为主流活动。天气预报尚不可得。
dc.notes_en: No verifiable Chinese/Asian family events found for this window (no Double Ninth events; La Vang Mid-Autumn Festival was in September), so all listings are mainstream. Weekend forecast not yet available.

events.title_zh: Josiah Henson 国际考古日家庭活动
events.title_en: International Archaeology Family Day
events.address: 11410 Old Georgetown Rd, North Bethesda, MD 20852
events.desc_zh: 动手考古体验与遗址导览。
events.desc_en: Hands-on archaeology activities and tours of the excavation site.

events.title_zh: Oxon Hill Farm 秋季节
events.title_en: Fall Festival at Oxon Hill Farm
events.address: 6411 Oxon Hill Rd, Oxon Hill, MD 20745
events.desc_zh: 国家公园管理局农场的免费秋季家庭活动(官网称内容仍在更新)。
events.desc_en: Free family fall festival at the NPS farm; the page notes details are still evolving.

events.title_zh: 国家航空航天博物馆 观日活动
events.title_en: Sungazing at the National Air and Space Museum
events.desc_zh: 在馆外用滤光望远镜安全观察太阳,工作人员讲解;天气不佳会取消。
events.desc_en: Safely view the Sun through a filtered telescope with staff; canceled in bad weather.

events.title_zh: Reston Farm 秋季节
events.title_en: Fall Fest at Reston Farm Garden Market
events.cost_zh: 以官网为准(3岁以上需购票)
events.desc_zh: 充气玉米迷宫、小动物园、滑梯和弹跳屋、小火车、苹果酒甜甜圈。
events.desc_en: Inflatable corn maze, petting zoo, slides, moon bounces, farm train and cider donuts.

events.title_zh: Gaver Farm 秋季农场节
events.title_en: Fall Fun Festival at Gaver Farm
events.cost_zh: $24/人(2岁以下免费),建议网上订票
events.desc_zh: 7英亩玉米迷宫、动物喂养、大滑梯、免费干草车(距DC约1小时车程)。
events.desc_en: 7-acre corn maze, animal feeding, giant slides and free hayrides. About an hour from DC.

events.title_zh: Little Jams 亲子公园音乐会
events.title_en: Little Jams: Jennifer Schimpf Trio
events.desc_zh: 周五上午的免费家庭现场音乐会。
events.desc_en: Free Friday-morning family concert in the park.
